lines.text: Jesus and His disciples leave Jericho with a large crowd, and blind Bartimaeus, son of Timaeus, sits beside the road.
Bartimaeus cries out to Jesus, Son of David, for mercy, and when many people tell him to be silent, he cries louder.
Jesus keeps walking and sends a disciple to call Bartimaeus, who is told to take courage and get up.

wrong_details.wrong: Jesus keeps walking and sends a disciple to call Bartimaeus
wrong_details.true: Jesus stopped and said, "Call him," and the people called the blind man

lines.text: Bartimaeus throws off his cloak and jumps up, and he asks Jesus, whom he calls Rabboni, to let him walk again.
Jesus says his faith has healed him, and Bartimaeus immediately receives his sight and follows Jesus along the road.
